verdict.rationale: A community comment reports that everything except the cloud app is open source, with code at github.com/viamrobotics and 'rdk' as the main repo. The GitHub evidence confirms a public RDK repository. Delivery is partial because the hosted cloud app is closed and no first-party statement names the license; one user's uncertainty about how much is truly open counts as skepticism, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: a named open-source license in first-party evidence, open source for the cloud app, and official documentation of the open-source scope.
